coverage_failure_rule: If either event slot is unavailable, select the next distinct eligible queue domain by hash order, label the unmet goal PILOT_COVERAGE_NOT_MET, and do not imply the selected account has the missing event.
distribution_rule: Report BASE_SAMPLE and TRACE_COVERAGE separately; combined counts are pilot execution counts only.
eligibility: company-domain identity may be established from the seller listing and the official company site; no exclusion based on Fit, Signal, prestige, Decision, or expected Action
readiness_note: This limited featured-page frame may fail to contain a qualifying fresh or stale event; preserve that result.
revision_reason: Manual verification cannot reliably finish by the initial collection cutoff; same roster and hash order, revised before continuing leadership screening.
roster_canonicalization: normalize www prefix; lowercase; sort domains lexicographically; join with LF and final LF
sampling_frame: Distinct company domains of seller entries visibly featured on three G2 Sales Enablement category pages at the recorded retrieval time; this is a featured-page frame, not the full 194-product category.
selection_key: SHA-256(UTF-8('gtm-m2b-v1:' + normalized_domain)); ascending hexadecimal; domain tie break
source_claim_rule: Only manually verified official company-level sources become imported FACT; no silence-derived ABSENT.
trace_coverage_slots: first eligible fresh new-revenue-leader event in queue order
first eligible stale new-revenue-leader event in queue order
